name: Convert to File
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Convert to File node to take input data and output it as a file. This converts the input JSON data into a binary format

operations.description: Enter the file name for the generated output file

operations.operation: If the first row of the file contains header names, turn on the Header Row option

operations.description: Enter the name of the field in the output data to contain the file
Enter the title for the event
Enter the date and time the event will start. All-day events ignore the time
Enter the date and time the event will end. All-day events ignore the time. If unset, the node uses the start date
Select whether the event is an all day event (turned on) or not (turned off)
Select whether the attendee needs to confirm attendance (turned on) or doesn't (turned off)
For Apple and Microsoft calendars, enter the calendar name for the event
Enter an event description
Enter the Latitude and Longitude for the event's location
Enter the event's intended venue/location
Enter a rule to define the repeat pattern of the event (RRULE). Generate rules using the iCalendar.org RRULE Tool
Enter the organizer's Name and Email
If you're sending an update for an event with the same universally unique ID (UID), enter the revision sequence number
Enter a universally unique ID (UID) for the event. The UID should be globally unique. The node automatically generates a UID if you don't enter one
Enter a URL associated with the event
Whether to use UTC time zone (turned off) or the workflow's timezone (turned on). Set the workflow's timezone in the Workflow Settings
Send all input items to a single file
Create a file for every input item
Choose whether to format the JSON for easier reading (turned on) or not (turned off)
Choose the character set to use to encode the data. The default is utf8
Choose whether to compress and reduce the file's output size
Turn on if the first row of the file contains header names
Enter the Sheet Name to create in the spreadsheet
Enter the MIME type of the output file. Refer to Common MIME types for a list of common MIME types and the file extensions they relate to
